title: No tests cover model-selection patch validation or key mapping
reasoning: The feature has no linked tests, while buildModelSettingsPatch enforces non-empty modelId/modelProvider, accepts provider as an alias, trims string inputs, and maps SDK field names to persisted/backend-style keys. A regression here would silently change the public SDK settings payload contract or error behavior.
recommendation: Add focused SDK tests for required modelId/modelProvider validation, provider alias handling, whitespace trimming, optional modelMode/interactionMode inclusion, and output key names.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature metadata lists no tests, and the package manifest only exposes build/prepack scripts, not a package-level test target.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a unit test module for buildModelSettingsPatch that asserts the exact patch object for valid selections and thrown errors for missing/blank modelId or provider values.
minimumFixScope: Add focused tests for packages/windie-sdk-js/src/settings/modelSelection.ts without changing runtime behavior.
